summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 campaign with just one week until the season kicks off, having welcomed several new signings and one returning player to strengthen the squad. The Ramblers recently suffered a narrow defeat to St Helens in what was a competitive match, but the team is determined to push for promotion this season. With three brand new kits and exciting additions to the roster, the club is also actively seeking sponsorship opportunities to support their ambitious goals.
